findings.scope: IdeaForm requires deliverable, expected check and registered command key from the user. PRD R01 explicitly says the user need not supply architecture, test commands or data fields. It creates a DRAFT Goal but no production planner consumes natural intent and generates validated task dependencies.
findings.resolution_gate: Implement natural-intent intake and bounded validated planning using existing entities and durable qualified execution; distinguish user facts from proposed direction; absent capability creates a real visible resource block. Do not hardcode invented Goal acceptance criteria or let untrusted model outputs change contracts directly.

findings.scope: createResearchCycle enforces scheduled-window coalescing when called, but control main has no production periodic trigger or source/verification/experiment/review stage driver. A READY-task executor loop alone does not create or advance research cycles.
findings.resolution_gate: One existing authority coordinator drives due windows and canonical stage transitions with stable IDs/current grants/cursors/budget and source gaps, retaining missing-source PARTIAL/BLOCKED. Reuse research and runtime functions; no second scheduler/queue or speculative fabricated evidence.

findings.scope: Reviewed protected-reference upgrade plan is intentionally exact schema13-to14 only; current development source already includes migration15 and runtime S1 reserves16. New first-release build needs an explicitly reviewed pinned plan for its final schema.
findings.resolution_gate: After final migrations freeze, add a distinct exact-version/hash plan with independent rollback and protected-reference continuity checks; preserve original13-to14 plan and rejection tests. No actual activation while policy block remains.

limits: Existing formally accepted narrow cases remain scoped and unchanged
No source edits, service launches, credentials, actual product data or provider requests
Does not authorize a new public API or changes to frozen contracts; design must first reconcile natural-intent bootstrap with current Goal/Task schema
